title: The Integer Alibi: Localizing Cross-Kernel Divergence in INT8-Quantized LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.13756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Two GPU kernels implementing the same scaled INT8 GEMM interface are usually treated as interchangeable. We test that assumption: holding the checkpoint, prompts, hardware, inference engine, decoding, and quantization configuration fixed, we swap only the INT8 linear kernel (CUTLASS versus Triton) inside vLLM. At 1.7B each arm reproduces itself bit-for-bit across cold restarts, yet the arms agree on no sequence in any end-to-end comparison we ran (0/8, 0/16, and 0/64). What makes this more than a benchmark discrepancy is an integer alibi: for shared INT8 operands under a verified no-overflow bound, the INT32 dot product is exact and order-independent, so the accumulator cannot be the source of any difference. translated_title: 整数不在场证明：定位INT8量化大语言模型推理中的跨内核差异
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13756v1 公告类型：新 摘要：两个实现相同缩放INT8 GEMM接口的GPU内核通常被视为可互换的。我们检验了这一假设：固定检查点、提示词、硬件、推理引擎、解码和量化配置，仅在vLLM内部交换INT8线性内核（CUTLASS与Triton）。在1.7B规模下，每次冷重启后每个分支都能逐位复现自身，但两个分支在我们运行的所有端到端比较中没有任何序列一致（0/8、0/16和0/64）。使其不仅仅是基准测试差异的原因在于整数不在场证明：对于共享的INT8操作数，在验证的无溢出边界下，INT32点积是精确且与顺序无关的，因此累加器不可能是任何差异的来源。从Qwen3-1.7B和8B的每个线性层（196层和252层）向两个内核提供相同的操作数，在2的幂次缩放下发现逐位相同的输出，确认了预先登记的预测列表196/196和252/252（预注册）。
tldr: 本文通过实验证明，在固定所有其他条件下，仅替换INT8线性内核（CUTLASS与Triton）会导致大语言模型推理输出完全不一致，并利用整数运算的精确性定位到差异源自内核实现而非累加器。
en_tdlr: This paper demonstrates that swapping only the INT8 linear kernel (CUTLASS vs Triton) causes complete output divergence in LLM inference under fixed conditions, and uses the exactness of integer arithmetic to localize the divergence to kernel implementation rather than the accumulator.
